blocks.text: The AquaGlow Protocol: A 60-Minute Skin Reset
blocks.html:
The AquaGlow Protocol:
A 60-Minute Skin Reset
Our therapists follow a high-touch, systematic approach:

1. Cleanse & Prepare

Double cleansing and gentle exfoliation melt away daily pollutants and soften the skin’s surface for safe extraction.

2. Steam & Professional Extraction

Using controlled steam to relax the pores, our therapists perform precise manual extractions to clear blackheads and stubborn congestion.

3. Botanical Collagen Infusion

We saturate the skin with a high-potency botanical collagen to soothe post-extraction redness and lock in moisture.

4. Calming Massage & Mask

A relaxing facial massage promotes circulation, followed by a calming mask and hydrating finish to leave skin comfortable and refreshed.
Frequently Asked Questions

• Will I be red after the treatment?

    Because we prioritise manual precision, any mild redness from extraction typically settles within a few hours, leaving behind a noticeably clearer complexion.

  • Does it hurt?

    We use steam and softening enzymes to make extractions as comfortable as possible. While you may feel slight pressure on congested areas, the overall experience remains deeply relaxing.

  • How often should I book?

    To keep pores clear and hydration levels optimal, we recommend an AquaGlow reset every 4 weeks.
